capabilities: Build UTM links from channel presets
Log created links in a Markdown registry table
Create per-link notes with YAML properties and a .base view
Audit UTM links in a note or from the clipboard
extras: Makes zero network requests and works on mobile with no external dependencies.
problem: Hand-built UTM links drift into inconsistent casing, missing tags and duplicates, and end up tracked in messy spreadsheets instead of the vault.
summary: Builds, normalises and validates UTM campaign links, logging them in a Markdown registry table or in per-link notes with YAML properties.
